title: Capture one production KV-context profile
objective: Turn observed decode KV lengths and incremental-prefill prefix/extend shapes into one auditable workload profile.
preconditions: A representative request trace or scheduler trace
steps: Record per-request decode KV length, batch bucket, cache dtype, page size, sparse top-k, and topology
Record incremental-prefill prefix_tokens, extend_tokens, batch/ragged distribution, graph mode, and selected backend
Choose weighted scenarios from observed frequency and tail percentiles; cite the trace source
Validate the profile with serving_native/context_matrix.py or serving_native/selftest.py

acceptance.pass: The profile covers decode and incremental prefill and every value is trace-backed.
acceptance.invalid: Convenient powers of two or a single fixed context are presented as production evidence.

stop_rule: Keep production_evidence=false until the deployment and every scenario have a concrete evidence source.
origin_evidence: The previous serving-native decode workload fixed context=8192 and had no incremental-prefill KV scenario.
